question: What utterances accompany the offering of flowers in all ritual contexts?
premises: Recitation of the mūla mantra is required in all offerings.
inference: In every offering of flowers, one utters vauṣaṭ and recites the mūla mantra.
plain_english: In all offerings of flowers, one should utter 'vauṣaṭ' and recite the root mantra.
